elements.element: Trigger: duties arise on expiry or termination of the Agreement
elements.evidence: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason
HDI shall ... provide reasonable transition assistance

elements.element: Transition assistance available for up to 6 months
elements.evidence: for a period of up to 6 months following the Termination Date
return to the Company all Content, user information and customer data of the Company then in HDI's possession or control

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format

elements.evidence: within 30 days after the Termination Date
thereafter delete all such Content, user information and customer data from its systems
certify such deletion to the Company in writing
up to 6 months following the Termination Date (exceeds 90 days)
within 30 days after the Termination Date, return to the Company all Content, user information and customer data

reasons: New Section 4.3 is a concise insertion into an agreement that was silent on exit, and it delivers every atomic element of the preferred position: transition assistance up to 6 months at then-current rates, return of Customer data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of the Termination Date, then deletion and written certification.

The 'at the Company's request' condition attaches only to limb (a) transition assistance; the mandatory data return in limb (b) and the deletion/certification in limb (c) are unconditional, so the request condition does not swallow the post-termination return obligation.

Qualifiers 'reasonable' and the request trigger on assistance are minor drafting softeners on the assistance limb only and do not defeat any preferred element; they are worth noting in rationale rather than treating as a failure.

No unrelated commercial term is disturbed: Sections 4.1 and 4.2 are untouched, the insertion uses the existing defined terms 'HDI', 'Company' and 'Termination Date', and no dangling mechanic or contradiction is introduced.
Margin comment accurately describes the operative change and offers the fallback, consistent with tone requirements.
